Render a validation report

Source: R/report.R
msa_report.Rd

Writes a self-contained validation report in the structure a reviewer or auditor expects: context of use and model risk, realised study design, precision (gauge R&R with intervals), agreement and accuracy against the reference, bias and linearity, robustness screening, the verdict against the acceptance criteria, and a traceability section with the data hash, R and package versions and the session information.

Usage

msa_report(
  grr,
  runs = NULL,
  boot = NULL,
  agreement = NULL,
  bias = NULL,
  robustness = NULL,
  cou = "",
  question = "",
  risk = c("medium", "low", "high"),
  acceptance = "",
  title = "Validation report: LLM pipeline as a measurement system",
  author = "",
  output_file = "validation_report.html",
  output_format = "html_document",
  quiet = TRUE,
  assessment = NULL
)

Arguments

grr

An msa_grr object (required).

runs

The msa_runs the analysis is based on (for the realised design and the data hash).

boot, agreement, bias, robustness

Optional results of msa_boot(), msa_agreement(), msa_bias() and msa_robustness().

cou

Context of use: what the pipeline output is used for and what decision it supports.

question

The question of interest the pipeline answers.

risk

Model risk tier (influence of the output on the decision times consequence of a wrong decision).

acceptance

Free-text acceptance criteria (e.g. "%GRR < 20 % of study variation, ndc >= 5, accuracy >= 90 %").

title, author

Report title and author.

output_file

Path of the rendered file.

output_format

Any rmarkdown output format, e.g. "html_document" (default) or "pdf_document" (needs LaTeX).

quiet

Suppress rendering output.

assessment

Optional list with criteria (a data.frame containing criterion and band, optionally value and note), verdict (one string), and sections (a named list of entries with character text and optional data.frame table). Validated before rendering. The supplied verdict is used in the conclusion; GRR remains in the precision section. NULL retains the original report. Application rules belong to the caller.

Value

The path of the rendered report, invisibly.

Details

The sections are filled from the objects supplied; omitted objects give an explicit "not assessed" entry rather than silence. Rendering needs the packages rmarkdown and knitr and a pandoc installation (RStudio and Positron ship one).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE) && rmarkdown::pandoc_available()) {
  fit <- msa_fit(ic50_demo, type = "numeric")
  out <- msa_report(msa_grr(fit), runs = ic50_demo,
                    bias = msa_bias(ic50_demo, "reference"),
                    cou = "Extraction of IC50 values from assay reports for a screening database",
                    question = "Is the extracted IC50 within assay precision?",
                    risk = "medium", acceptance = "%GRR < 30 %, ndc >= 5, |bias| < 0.1 log10 units",
                    output_file = tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
  out
}
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmp2K5P9C/file19383e8b51a1.html"
# }
